status: draft: the covers mapping is an unreviewed judgement and must be confirmed by the specification owners
note: Requirement IDs are the Xt-EHR D5.1 IDs the specification itself uses. The EHDS implementing acts under Articles 15 and 36 (still in draft) will define the final requirements: when they do, change only this table and the covers mapping. D5.1 also has 6 logging-component and 5 general requirements that the specification leaves out of scope; they are not listed here and have no tests in this repository. Three sides exist: server and client (the system under test is called or calls) and producer (it produces a document that is validated).

api-provider-general.text: The EHR system acting as a provider SHALL provide access to its priority category data by offering an API that complies to the EHDS API specification.

api-provider-backendAuthDiscovery.text: The EHR system Interoperability Software Component SHALL enable discovery of its authorization server information to enable a consumer to retrieve authorization.

api-provider-backendAuthProvideToken.text: The EHR system Interoperability Software Component SHALL support issuing authorization tokens to consumer EHR systems.

api-provider-backendAuthRequireToken.text: The EHR system Interoperability Software Component SHALL require a valid authorization token from the Consumer EHR on Interoperability Component exchange.

api-provider-patient.text: The EHR system Interoperability Software Component SHOULD offer a patient lookup API.

api-provider-doc.text: The EHR system Interoperability Software Component SHALL offer an API that enables an external system to access and retrieve its priority category data modelled as FHIR Documents.

api-provider-resource.text: The EHR system Interoperability Software Component SHALL offer search and read access via individual FHIR Resource API(s).

api-consumer-general.text: The EHR system Interoperability Software Component acting as a consumer SHALL consume external priority category data via an API conforming to the EHDS API specification.

api-consumer-backendAuthObtainToken.text: The EHR system Interoperability Software Component SHALL obtain an authorization token from the provider's designated authorization server.

api-consumer-backendAuthPresentToken.text: The EHR system Interoperability Software Component SHALL present a valid token to the Provider EHR on Interoperability Component Exchange.

api-consumer-patient.text: The EHR system Interoperability Software Component SHALL support an external patient lookup query API.

api-consumer-doc.text: The EHR system Interoperability Software Component SHALL support an external document query API.

api-consumer-resource.text: The EHR system Interoperability Software Component SHALL support an external resource query API.

api-producer-data.text: The EHR system SHALL be capable of providing priority category data that conforms to the EEHRxF data format.

api-consumer-data.text: The EHR system SHALL be able to receive and handle data conforming to the EEHRxF data format.

api-backendEncryption.text: The EHR system Interoperability Component SHALL be capable of transport-encrypted data exchange.

DocumentReference.create.note: Server side: the Document Submission Option, which the specification states is not required to satisfy any D5.1 requirement. Client side: the Delegated Access Option, the Document Publisher satisfying §2.1 by publishing to an Access Provider.
